issues.description: Class name mismatch and malformed template file: the template file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java declares a class named 'AnimalFarm' (line 3) and contains duplicated/embedded package/class blocks (lines 10-17), whereas the problem statement UML and the solution expect a public class named 'Farm' (problem_statement.md lines 16-22, solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 6). This prevents students from implementing or compiling the intended Farm class (methods such as addAnimal, feedAllAnimals, singFarmSong) and blocks following the UML/design.
issues.suggestedFix: Fix the template file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java so its public class matches the exercise UML and solution: (1) remove duplicate/malformed package and nested code blocks, (2) rename the class from 'AnimalFarm' to 'Farm' (public class Farm), and (3) provide a correct skeleton matching the UML — private List<Animal> animals, a no-argument constructor that initializes animals = new ArrayList<>(), getters/setters, and method stubs for addAnimal(Animal), feedAllAnimals(), singFarmSong(), and a private singFarmSongVerse(Animal). This will align the template with the problem statement and solution and allow students to compile and implement the remaining tasks.
